properties.html: 'A' was born two years ago, when B was two years old. At present, the average age (in years) of A, B, C and D is a perfect square. Also the difference between the ages of any two persons is not more than five years. Which of the following could be the ages of C and D (in years)?

questionFeedback:
Sorry, that's not correct.
Explanation:

A's and B's present ages are 2 and 4 years respectively.
Also (A + B + C + D)/4 = Perfect square Thus 1 can not be considered.
Let it be 4.
⇒ A + B + C + D = 16
⇒C + D = 10
Also given that the age difference of any two persons is not more than five years. Hence the ages of C and D could be 7 and 3 years, satisfying all the conditions.
But when it be 9 ⇒A + B + C + D = 36
⇒C + D = 30 

Thus age difference of any two persons now becomes more than five years. Hence this case is discarded.

Explanation:

A four-digit number will be a multiple of 9 if the sum of its digits is also a multiple of 9:
Case 1:
The number consists of all 9s. The number is 9999 and is divisible by 9. Only one number of this type can be formed.
Case 2:
The number consists of three 9s and one 3. The sum of the digits is 30. The number is not divisible by 9. Case 3:
